Strong skin barrier with thick Cica Cream Intense

What it is: Moisturizing cica cream infused with 7 types of centella extract to soothe sensitive skin and provide deep hydration

Size: 1.7 fl.oz / 50ml

WHY IT'S SPECIAL:

  • 61.2% of Pure Fit CICA-7 Complex
    Large amount of Pure Fit Cica-7 Complex infused with 7 types of centella extract effectively soothes even the most sensitive skin. Calm, soothe, and recover your skin with Pure Fit Cica Cream Intense.
  • High moisture, High protection
    The protective barrier made from 1,000 ppm of Centella Asiatica Oil + Panthenol + Allantoin protects moisture and keeps skin hydrated for a long time. Strongly recommended for those with extremely dry skin, or for use in dry seasons.
  • Thick texture
    The thick, creamy texture of Cica Cream Intense allows the cream to penetrate deep into skin without stickiness.

How to use:

Apply a proper amount evenly onto face as last step of skincare and pat it gently for better absorption.
